root_cause.text: In the SCTP_SENDALL path of sctp_sendmsg(), net/sctp/socket.c used list_for_each_entry_safe() over ep->asocs even though sctp_sendmsg_to_asoc() can drop the socket lock, leaving the cached next association pointer (@tmp) stale while other threads can migrate or free that list entry.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE/commit states that list_for_each_entry_safe() caches @tmp before the loop body, sctp_sendmsg_to_asoc() may release the lock in sctp_wait_for_sndbuf(), “nothing revalidates @tmp,” and the fix explicitly adds `tmp = list_next_entry(asoc, asocs);` after return to re-derive the cursor because the old cached @tmp could be peeled off or freed.

intent_record.intent_summary: Recompute the SCTP association-list iterator after lock release so sendmsg does not use a stale cursor when associations may have changed.
intent_record.what: A new comment block and one assignment were added after iov_iter_revert(&msg->msg_iter, err); in sctp_sendmsg(): tmp = list_next_entry(asoc, asocs);. The comment explains that sctp_sendmsg_to_asoc() may release the socket lock while waiting for sndbuf, allowing other associations in ep->asocs to be peeled off or freed, so the cached list cursor must be recomputed from asoc.
intent_record.how: At runtime, after returning from a path where the socket lock may have been temporarily released, the code now refreshes the iteration cursor used for the association list. This prevents continued use of a potentially stale next-list pointer if the association list changed while unlocked, avoiding traversal of invalid or freed list entries and preserving correct iteration state.

grouping_result.intent: Recompute the SCTP association-list iterator after lock release so sendmsg does not use a stale cursor when associations may have changed.

relevance_review.reason: The change directly addresses the root cause: in the SCTP_SENDALL loop, the iterator must be recomputed after sctp_sendmsg_to_asoc() may drop the socket lock, preventing use of a stale next association pointer if the list changed.
